caption: The drawing features a simple arrangement of objects rendered in shades of blue and tan on a beige background. At the upper center of the image, there is an outline of a crock or ceramic container with two side handles. The crock’s body has a label that reads "CROCK & BROTHERS HUNTINGTON L.I. 4" and displays two blue painted floral-like shapes along with a curved line of small blue dots. Below the crock, in the main compositional area, there are two large blue floral shapes resembling clusters of petals, positioned symmetrically toward the left and right. Beneath these shapes, a curved line of blue spots or stones runs horizontally, resembling a string of beads. The entire composition is set against a softly shaded tan area that contrasts with the plain beige of the rest of the paper.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
